# Test fixture manifest

Every file under `tests/fixtures/` must be listed here with its provenance. Fixtures are
**synthetic or pseudonymized**; no real handles, e-mails or raw records (WORK_ORDER §6). The
private-data scan fails on unlisted fixtures.

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/generate.py` | Generator for the GH Archive fixtures below (M1-T3). Deterministic; fake logins (`userNNNN`, `farmNNNN`, `helper-app[bot]`, `ci-bot`) and fake repos (`org-a/repo-1`, …). |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-0.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour (generated by `generate.py`): velocity burst on org-a/repo-1, bot star/fork. |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-1.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour: burst continues; lockstep farm burst on org-b/repo-2; malformed line. |
| `tests/fixtures/gharchive/2026-09-20-2.json.gz` | Synthetic GH Archive hour: tail activity; background repo org-c/repo-3. |
